thread:
Emma: Heads-up — I sketched a single ‘Fleet Operability’ Grafana dashboard that combines utilization, memory fragmentation, per-rack PDU power, and network egress so on-call has one screen for triage.
Emma: Goal: reduce back-and-forth between 3 dashboards during incidents and catch cross-metric anomalies (e.g., memory fragmentation + thermal skew + high egress).
Raj: Nice. What panels do you want on the first row? keep it compact for 1080p.
Emma: First row idea:
- cluster-wide 1m util p50/p95 + tops-10 noisy nodes
- memory fragmentation histogram across GPUs
- rack PDU aggregate power (W) with per-rack sparkline
- network egress per-rack (MB/s)
Olivia: For memory fragmentation I suggest a derived metric — %fragment = 100 * (1 - used_allocated_ratio). Example promql:

```promql
100 * (1 - (sum by (gpu) (dcgm_gpu_allocated_memory_bytes{}) / sum by (gpu) (dcgm_gpu_physical_memory_bytes{})))
```

Olivia: Then show a histogram 0-100%. color > 40% as warning.
Simon: Can we also include KV cache hit rate? Some latency spikes map to low kv cache hits. Query idea:

```promql
avg by (node) (rate(model_kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) / (rate(model_kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(model_kv_cache_misses_total[5m])))
```

Mike: On power panels — make sure we normalize per-GPU for mixed racks. e.g., watts per-GPU = total_rack_watts / count(gpus_online)
Mike: Promql for watts/GPU:

```promql
(sum by (rack) (pdu_power_watts{env="prod"}) / sum by (rack) (gpu_online_count{env="prod"}))
```

Raj: Alert tuning suggestions: 99p util > 98% for 3m -> page. 95-98% warning to slack. For memory fragmentation: page if > 65% for 10m.
Emma: Agree. Also add a multi-metric alert rule that fires if (99p util > 96% AND avg temp delta > 8C across GPUs in rack) -> auto annotate the dashboard and include runbook link.
Simon: What's the temp delta query? I have something like:

```promql
max by (rack) (dcgm_avg_gpu_temp_celsius{}) - min by (rack) (dcgm_avg_gpu_temp_celsius{})
```

Olivia: For ops, add a panel that overlays allocation churn (pods created / deleted per min) with network egress to detect noisy tenant behavior.
Emma: UX: top-left incident summary (last 1h anomalies), top-right action buttons link to runbooks and the node list (Grafana plugin). Middle: metric matrix. Bottom: logs tail (loki) filtered by selected rack/node.
Mike: Can we include a tiny panel with estimated cost burn rate (USD/hr) for the selected rack based on power * $/kWh? quick calc panel using Grafana transformations.
Raj: Yes — need a constant var for $/kWh and efficiency factor. I can add an annotation with the formula.
Emma: Also want a compact 'health score' per rack (0-100) derived from weighted metrics (util, temp, fragmentation, p99 latency). We can compute in Prometheus via recording rules or in Grafana using transformations.
Simon: I'll prototype the dashboard JSON export. ETA end of day tomorrow.
Olivia: I'll draft the alert rules and thresholds in a PR after Simon posts JSON.
dashbot: dashboard.upload: uid=ops_fleet_overview | version=1 | by=Simon | ts=1965250022
Raj: :thumbsup: Simon — once you push JSON I can kick off a canary rollout to staging.
Emma: Great, thanks team. If you hit blockers call me or ping #eng-oncall; I’ll help tune thresholds during the first week.
Mike: One more ask — add an option to switch between per-GPU and per-inference normalization. Some tenants care about per-inference p99 not per-GPU util.
Emma: Noted — add variable toggle for normalization mode.
Raj: Filing a small follow-up to capture panel sizes and recommended thresholds: https://go/infra-dashboards/ops-fleet-overview (doc stub)
Simon: Will post the initial JSON and link to grafana dashboard UID when ready.
